summary: Serializer::collect_str unconditionally panicked via unreachable!(). The fix formats the value twice: first to count UTF-8 bytes, then to emit those bytes after a varint length prefix, matching string serialization. The implementation reversal is exact and isolated. Blocked: the fix adds no tests, and inspection of existing unit, integration, and documentation tests found no test exercising collect_str at this revision. Existing string tests exercise serialize_str instead. No builds or tests were run.
